title: GL-16 — Private DNS
stopChargesPanel: Delete the app A record with a DELETE change batch, then the private hosted zone, then the VPC. No public domain purchase.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Route 53 private DNS; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Create VPC
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 create-vpc --cidr-block 10.160.0.0/16 --query Vpc.VpcId --output text --tag-specifications "ResourceType=vpc,Tags=[{Key=LabId,Value=gl-16}]"`.
Success: `$VpcId` is set.

steps.title: Private hosted zone
bullets: Run `$ZoneId = aws route53 create-hosted-zone --name workbook.gl16.local --vpc VPCRegion=us-east-1,VPCId=$VpcId --caller-reference gl16-$(Get-Random) --hosted-zone-config Comment=gl16,PrivateZone=true --query HostedZone.Id --output text`.
Success: private zone is created.

steps.title: Private record
bullets: Run `$Utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl16-record.json", '{"Changes":[{"Action":"CREATE","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"app.workbook.gl16.local","Type":"A","TTL":300,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"10.160.1.10"}]}}]}', $Utf8)`. This saves a CREATE change batch for the A record app.workbook.gl16.local → 10.160.1.10 with TTL 300, as UTF-8 without a BOM.
Run `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $ZoneId --change-batch file://gl16-record.json`.
Success: record exists.

steps.title: List records
bullets: Run `aws route53 list-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $ZoneId`.
Success: app record is listed.

steps.title: Delete record
bullets: Run `$Utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl16-record-delete.json", '{"Changes":[{"Action":"DELETE","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"app.workbook.gl16.local","Type":"A","TTL":300,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"10.160.1.10"}]}}]}', $Utf8)`. A DELETE must repeat the exact name, type, TTL, and value from "Private record".
Run `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id $ZoneId --change-batch file://gl16-record-delete.json`.
Success: only NS/SOA remain.

steps.title: Delete zone and VPC
bullets: Run `aws route53 delete-hosted-zone --id $ZoneId`.
Run `aws ec2 delete-vpc --vpc-id $VpcId`.
Success: both are gone.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: A private hosted zone bills a small prorated monthly charge per zone plus per-million-query charges; the VPC itself is free, and there is no EC2 instance in this lab.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: the app A record (DELETE change batch), zone, VPC. If "Delete record" already deleted the record, the DELETE returns InvalidChangeBatch (not found); continue with the next line
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-16` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources (the hosted zone) can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-16 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-16 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-16. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: One Route 53 private hosted zone linked to your VPC with one private A record.
